title: Eventual vanishing of descended scalar sections
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transition maps, and $(X,\pi)$ its limit [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For a scheme map $q$, write $B_q$ for base change on the small étale category, $q^*$ for inverse image on abelian sheaves, and $\eta_{q,H}(T):H(T)\to(q^*H)(B_qT)$ for the evaluated adjunction unit [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $F_i$ be abelian sheaves on $D_i$ with maps $\varphi_{ij}:p_{ji}^*F_i\to F_j$ satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\mathrm{Ab}(X_{\acute et})$ with isomorphisms $e_i:G_i\simeq\pi_i^*F_i$ whose transitions are $e_j^{-1}\circ\pi_j^*\varphi_{ij}\circ\chi_{ij}\circ e_i$, where $\chi$ is the canonical inverse-image composition comparison. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone of $G$, with apex $H$ and legs $\lambda_i$. Fix $i_0\in I$ and a qcqs étale object $T_0$ over $D_{i_0}$. Put $J=\{j\mid i_0\le j\}$, $T_j=B_{p_{ji_0}}T_0$, and $T_X=B_{\pi_{i_0}}T_0$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose given isomorphisms $\gamma_a:B_{p_{kj}}T_j\simeq T_k$ for $a:j\to k$ and $\delta_j:B_{\pi_j}T_j\simeq T_X$. Require their underlying first projections to $T_0$ to equal the iterated first projections (their base projections are fixed because they are arrows over the base scheme). Define $\rho_a=F_k(\gamma_a^{-1})\circ\varphi_{jk}(B_{p_{kj}}T_j)\circ\eta_{p_{kj},F_j}(T_j)$ and $\mu_j=H(\delta_j^{-1})\circ\lambda_j(B_{\pi_j}T_j)\circ e_j^{-1}(B_{\pi_j}T_j)\circ\eta_{\pi_j,F_j}(T_j)$. Then (1) every $x\in H(T_X)$ is $\mu_j(z)$ for some $j\in J$ and $z\in F_j(T_j)$; (2) if $\mu_j(z)=0$, there exist $k\in J$ and $a:j\to k$ with $\rho_a(z)=0$.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_limit_scalar_sections_zero_eventually
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (i₀ : I) (T₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    [CompactSpace T₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T₀.left] :
    let J := {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}
    let Tj := fun j : J ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
        (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)).obj T₀
    let Tlim := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj T₀
    ∀ (γ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tj k)
      (δ : ∀ j : J,
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tlim),
      (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (γ j k a).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE k.property).op) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
      (∀ j : J,
        (δ j).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (c.π.app (op i₀)) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (c.π.app (op j.val)) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
    let ρ := fun (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) ↦
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Tj j)) ≫
        (φ (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a)).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        (F k.val).obj.map (γ j k a).inv.op
    let μ := fun j : J ↦
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (c.π.app (op j.val))).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Tj j)) ≫
        (eG j.val).inv.hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        (L.ι.app j.val).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        L.pt.obj.map (δ j).inv.op
    (∀ (j : J) (z : (F j.val).obj.obj (op (Tj j))), μ j z = 0 →
      ∃ (k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), ρ j k a z = 0)
